name: ZeroCloud Share
description: Send files from any device to any device, whenever you need to.
introduction: We’re building Share for the moment you need to hand something over. Choose a file and the device that should receive it.

overview.heading: A file. A device. A handoff.

steps.title: Choose a file
steps.description: Start on the device that has what you want to send.

steps.title: Choose the destination
steps.description: Pick the device that should receive it, wherever you use Share.

steps.title: Send it directly
steps.description: An encrypted handoff is the requirement, from sender to recipient.

note.title: Share sends. Bucket keeps in sync.
note.description: Use Share for a transfer. Choose Bucket when you want a collection to stay available and up to date across devices.

faqs.question: How is Share different from Bucket?
faqs.answer: Share is for a transfer whenever you need one. Bucket keeps a collection stored and automatically synced across the devices you choose.

faqs.question: Does Share only work on a local network?
faqs.answer: The goal is sharing from any device to any device. A local network is one way for devices to reach each other, rather than the limit of the product.

faqs.question: Who receives my files?
faqs.answer: Share is being designed around the recipient you choose. Device approval and encrypted transfers are requirements for the app.

faqs.question: When is a local transfer useful?
faqs.answer: A reachable local connection can move a file without an internet upload or a cloud transfer fee. Its speed still depends on the devices and the network between them.
